_note: Extra exploration states for the plan 10 §7 gates and catalog reach: views a learner reaches with the camera rig (walk, look up, the Go to Spur crater button). Module states m1-m5 come from the stepper. The orbit view (m1) is the secondary scene (3 catalog objects), so it is not a main scene.

extraStates.name: sky-earth
extraStates.label: Look up at Earth from the LM

steps.eval: (() => { const d = window.__TEST__.scene.surface.sky.sunDir; window.__TEST__.lessons.lookToward({ x: d.x, y: Math.max(0.12, d.y * 0.7), z: d.z }, 14, 12, 0.05); })()

extraStates.name: sky-overhead
extraStates.label: Watch the orbiter climb from the eastern horizon

steps.eval: (() => { const d = window.__TEST__.scene.surface.sky.orbiterDirection(0.2); window.__TEST__.lessons.lookToward({ x: d.x, y: d.y - 0.1, z: d.z }, 14, 12, 0.05); })()

extraStates.name: sky-north
extraStates.label: Look up at the northern sky (stars)
